behavior: Durably and idempotently reserve stock for one order-placement operation and publish the resulting stock-decrease fact once per logical delivery identity.
postconditions: First successful operation decrements stock once and stores a terminal outcome.
Same OperationId and payload returns the stored outcome with WasAlreadyProcessed=true.
Same OperationId with different ProductId or Quantity returns OperationIdentityConflict without mutation.
A stored failure remains the replay result after stock changes.
Successful publication uses OperationId as stable MessageId and ProductId as partition key.
